manual:ss26-liz-timeline-p163.sourceText: 1447 AA - As Karrask falls to Asarta, Khugra begs for their protection from the foreign interlopers inside the country. Unfortunately, the interlopers are quick to act - most of Shagadyrran tribesmen secede to Rayaz, while the eastern border gets lost to Nazhni in a border skirmish, before the deal is finalised. Asarta is left with a sliver of coastline as a vassal, including Khugra city.
